description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.
The UID that indicates the resource ownership.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

description.zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
description.en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified.

title.en: Connect a cloud service to WAF

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi create-cloud-resource --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --listen '{"CustomCiphers":["ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384"],"ResourceRegionId":"cn-hangzhou","TLSVersion":"tlsv1","Http2Enabled":true,"CipherSuite":1,"EnableTLSv3":true,"Port":80,"ResourceProduct":"clb4","Certificates":[{"AppliedType":"default","CertificateId":"123-cn-hangzhou"}],"Protocol":"http","Domain":"www.c00sw.net","ResourceInstanceId":"lb-bp100000"}' --redirect '{"MaxBodySize":2,"XffHeaders":["header1"],"WriteTimeout":1,"XffHeaderMode":1,"Keepalive":true,"RequestHeaders":[{"Value":"value1","Key":"key1"}],"ReadTimeout":1,"KeepaliveRequests":1000,"KeepaliveTimeout":3600,"XffProto":true}' --tag Value=TagValue1 Key=TagKey1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --owner-user-id 123 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
